ctx.x: And I guess maybe he could have come over here because he was a very close friend of Hurok's, you know. Then later on they did a lot of work together and we had a second "Chocolate Kitties" with he and Hurok. See both of them were from Russia together. I think that they had been kids in Russia at the same time. So he knew that, but this was his first venture. And so far, it was his greatest.
And you were actually, then, when you opened in Berlin, you were already booked for other cities, or other countries, or what? Was it supposed to be a whole tour?
